title: SUT Audit Summary
description: Structured summary of the capability audit of one testing laboratory ecosystem, the system under test (SUT), in study EUS-2026-001. Validates the structured summary of audits/<SUT>/audit.md and a future audits/<SUT>/audit.json. Scores are provisional per-modality rubric levels (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md) and remain provisional until adjudication; no aggregated or weighted score exists. Score 0 cells remain in the summary with their structural_scope_note; there is no N/A level. Cross-cutting properties are descriptive only at v1. Evidence is referenced by evidence_id only. Schema state: DRAFT; changes follow protocol/change-control-v1.md.

ecosystem_id.description: Identifier of the audited ecosystem (system under test).

ecosystem_name.description: Human-readable ecosystem name as listed in protocol/study-design-v1.md.

role.description: Study role of the ecosystem as listed in protocol/study-design-v1.md (general-purpose candidate, general-purpose baseline, or specialist baseline with its specialty).

audit_directory.description: Repository-relative audit directory for this ecosystem.

auditor_role.description: Agent role that performed the audit, from protocol/agent-governance-v1.md. Each auditor role is bound to exactly one ecosystem.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version the audit was conducted under, for example v1.

rubric_version.description: Version of protocol/capability-rubric-v<n>.md applied, for example v1.

evidence_rules_version.description: Version of protocol/evidence-rules-v<n>.md applied, for example v1.

audit_status.description: Lifecycle state of the audit. NOT_STARTED is the only valid state during repository setup.

started_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD date at which the audit began. Null while NOT_STARTED.

submitted_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD date at which the auditor submitted the audit for adjudication. Null until SUBMITTED.

components.description: Ecosystem components examined during the audit, with their confirmed presence and exact provenance.

component.description: Component name as listed in the ecosystem's manifest under manifests/.

presence.description: Whether the auditor confirmed the component exists (CONFIRMED), confirmed it does not exist (ABSENT), or could not determine either (UNCONFIRMED).

repository.description: Repository or artifact source of the component. Null when unknown or not applicable.

commit_sha_or_release.description: Exact commit SHA, release tag, or the strongest reproducible identifier pinned in manifests/ for the version examined. Null when unknown or not applicable. Never approximate.

endpoint.description: Base URL, package identifier, or other locator of the component. Null when unknown or not applicable.

verified_by.description: Role that verified this surface's provenance or presence (manifests/README.md provenance sequence).

modality_assessments.description: One entry per assessed modality from the frozen v1 modality list. Absent or empty until the audit produces assessments.

provisional_score.description: Provisional rubric level for this modality per protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md (0 UNSUPPORTED, 1 TECHNICALLY EXECUTABLE, 2 EXPERIMENTALLY USABLE, 3 EXPERIMENTALLY CONTROLLABLE). Null while not yet assessed. Under the tie-break rule ('Tie-break rule for undecidable adjacent scores', protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md) this is the auditor's candidate level, which may exceed confirmed_score when the evidence only partially supports it.

confirmed_score.description: The score entered into every count, frequency table, and comparison (protocol/statistical-analysis-plan-v1.md; analysis/README.md), per protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md, 'Tie-break rule for undecidable adjacent scores': the highest rubric level whose complete requirements are fully supported by the available admissible evidence. Omitted or equal to provisional_score when the tie-break rule was not invoked (the ordinary case, no ambiguity); recorded as a distinct, lower value only when the rule caps the auditor's provisional_score. Never higher than provisional_score.

confirmation_state.description: Set only when provisional_score is 3 (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md, 'Score 3 confirmation'; protocol/study-design-v1.md, section 13, issue (x), RESOLVED). Derived from the evidence_status of the supporting evidence records, not chosen independently: UNCONFIRMED_SCORE_3 when the only supporting record is DOCUMENTED; CONFIRMED when at least one SOURCE_VERIFIED or EXECUTION_VERIFIED record supports the mechanism (EXECUTION_VERIFIED is the required confirming status where SOURCE_VERIFIED is unobtainable, protocol/study-design-v1.md, section 10.4). Only a CONFIRMED Score 3 is an adjudicated Score 3 and enters a confirmed Score 3 count (protocol/statistical-analysis-plan-v1.md, section 4.3, H1). Null for provisional_score 0, 1, or 2.

evidence_status_summary.description: Distinct evidence statuses present among the evidence records supporting this assessment, per protocol/evidence-rules-v1.md.

evidence_record_count.description: Number of evidence records in audits/<SUT>/evidence.csv that support this assessment.

evidence_refs.description: evidence_id values (protocol/evidence-rules-v1.md) of the supporting evidence records. CSV row or line numbers are never used.

rationale.description: Auditor's justification for the provisional level, referencing the rubric criteria and the evidence.

structural_scope_note.description: Descriptive only (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md, 'Structural scope note'): one of NO_WEB_SURFACE, NO_MOBILE_SURFACE, NO_API_SURFACE, INTENTIONAL_SPECIALIST_SCOPE, OTHER_STRUCTURAL_REASON, optionally followed by ': ' and free text; the free text is required for OTHER_STRUCTURAL_REASON. Filled when the modality is absent or narrow for a structural reason; null otherwise. Never replaces or modifies provisional_score; Score 0 remains Score 0 and no N/A level exists.

verification_refs.description: verification_id values (SUT0n-VR-nnnn) of the execution verification records supporting EXECUTION_VERIFIED evidence for this modality (protocol/evidence-rules-v1.md). Empty when none.

cross_cutting_properties.description: Descriptive assessment of the eight cross-cutting properties defined in protocol/cross-cutting-properties-v1.md. Descriptive only, never scored at v1.

Cross-platform Scenario Parity.description: Descriptive assessment of Cross-platform Scenario Parity.

Cross-layer State Continuity.description: Descriptive assessment of Cross-layer State Continuity.

limitations.description: Limitations of the audit itself (access, time, tooling, environment) that qualify its conclusions.

unresolved.description: Questions the auditor could not settle and that are handed to adjudication.

adjudication.description: Adjudication outcome recorded by the adjudicator role. Null until the audit is ADJUDICATED.

adjudicator_role.description: Agent role that adjudicated the audit, from protocol/agent-governance-v1.md.

disputed_cells.description: Modality cells of this ecosystem whose provisional level was disputed during adjudication.

note.description: Nature of the dispute and how it was resolved, or that it remains open.

environment_types_used.description: Distinct environment types (protocol/study-design-v1.md, section 10.1) under which EXECUTION_VERIFIED evidence was collected during the audit. Empty when the audit produced no EXECUTION_VERIFIED record. Provenance only; never a score input.

controlled_instance_available.description: Per-ecosystem fact verified during E01 and transcribed by the ORCHESTRATOR into manifests/sut-manifest.yaml: true when every component surface that E01 confirmed present can be run by the study, from the pinned evaluated version, in a controlled environment (SELF_HOSTED or LOCAL for web and api service components; EMULATED or SIMULATED for android and ios application builds); false otherwise, naming the components that cannot in the audit limitations. Null until verified. An experimental-control fact (protocol/study-design-v1.md, sections 10.1 and 10.5), never a score input.
